title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
script:
Preorders for the new Microduck robots just topped twenty thousand units. Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang showcased these tiny bots at a recent appearance.
These little machines stomp their feet and make distinct, tiny R2-D2 noises.
They perform specific actions like sitting, falling down for a nap, and somersaulting.
Every movement triggers instantly whenever you provide the correct voice command.
The robots are currently positioning themselves as the holiday season's must-have toy.
Would you keep one of these on your desk?
